title: Help improve Legal Masr
subtitle: Report a problem or tell us what would make your working day easier.
details: Include version 0.2.4, your operating system, what you tried and what happened. A short example with fictional data is enough.
privacy: Do not send client names, case documents, passwords, recovery keys or backups. Contact opens your chosen mail app; nothing is sent automatically. This website and installer downloads use Cloudflare hosting, which processes standard connection metadata such as IP addresses. Website language and theme preferences are saved in your browser.
